sender.en: A video of a famous tycoon, politician or news anchor on Facebook or YouTube

how.en: A video on social media shows a well-known businessman, senator or mayor, or a fake news report, recommending an investment, crypto platform or “investment adviser”. The face and voice are made with AI. You are sent to a trading site or a chat “adviser” who asks for a deposit, your card details or OTP. After paying, you cannot withdraw and the contact disappears. The SEC and the people shown say they endorse no such investment.

text.en: An ad or video shows a famous person or a news show recommending an investment.
It promises big profits from a small deposit.
You are sent to a website or a chat “adviser” to register.
You are asked for a deposit, card details or the OTP.
[Video] “I personally invest in this platform. Filipinos can start with P15,000 and earn up to P50,000 a week. Register now, slots are limited.” Message our account manager to begin.
